name: Bekero Mobile Bottom Menu
author: bekero

sections.description:
This plugin adds a customizable sticky bottom menu to your WooCommerce store, visible only on mobile devices. It provides an app-like navigation experience with 5 key items: Menu, Search, Cart, Favorites, and Account.

Features:
* Show/Hide on scroll.
* Glassmorphism effect.
* Customizable colors and border radius.
* Dynamic cart count bubble.
* Fully integrated with WooCommerce.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bekero-mobile-bottom-menu directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Settings->Woo Mobile Menu screen to configure the plugin.
